description: Three clock-locked oscillators with a state-variable filter on each, their three outputs available separately and as a mix

params.text: Picks oscillator I's ratio to the incoming clock from the current scale
Picks oscillator II's ratio to the incoming clock from the current scale
Picks oscillator III's ratio to the incoming clock from the current scale
Switched to Subaudio the three filter frequencies are divided by 1000, putting their corners below the audio band; switched to Audio they run at the frequency the knobs and CV set
Attenuverts the I ratio CV input, -1 to +1
Attenuverts the II ratio CV input, -1 to +1
Attenuverts the III ratio CV input, -1 to +1
Steps through oscillator I's waveform: Saw, Square or Triangle
Steps forward through the eight scales of the loaded scale file, wrapping round at the end
Steps through oscillator II's waveform: Saw, Square or Triangle
Switches between Independent Ratios, where each CV input picks its own oscillator's ratio, and II + III and Phase Modulation, where one input moves both and the other becomes a phase modulation input
Steps backward through the eight scales of the loaded scale file, wrapping round at the start
Steps through oscillator III's waveform: Saw, Square or Triangle
Sets the resonance of that oscillator's filter, -5V to +5V worth; turning it up also quietens the signal going into the filter, which keeps the resonant peak in bounds
Sets the corner frequency of that oscillator's filter, -5V to +5V worth, one octave per volt
Morphs that oscillator's filter between low pass at fully counter-clockwise, band pass at the centre and high pass at fully clockwise
Attenuates the shared resonance CV input before it is added to all three resonance knobs
Attenuates the shared frequency CV input before it is added to all three frequency knobs
Attenuates the shared filter-type CV input before it is added to all three filter-type knobs
Pressing this sets the tempo the three oscillators lock to, in place of a pulse at the Sync input

inputs.text: Modulates that oscillator's filter corner, one octave per volt, added to its frequency knob and to the shared frequency CV
Picks oscillator I's ratio, through the I CV scale attenuverter
Picks oscillator II's ratio, or both II and III together when the CV mapping button is on its second setting, through the II CV scale attenuverter
Picks oscillator III's ratio, or phase-modulates the pair when the CV mapping button is on its second setting, through the III CV scale attenuverter
The clock all three oscillators lock to; each rising edge is measured to work out the tempo
Adds to all three resonance knobs at once, through the resonance CV scale trimmer
Adds to all three filter corner knobs at once, one octave per volt, through the frequency CV scale trimmer, despite the maker's tooltip naming it a resonance CV
Adds to all three filter-type knobs at once, through the filter-type CV scale trimmer, despite the maker's tooltip naming it a resonance CV

outputs.text: A 5V trigger when oscillator I's ratio changes
Oscillator I through its own filter
A 5V trigger when oscillator II's ratio changes
Oscillator II through its own filter
A 5V trigger when oscillator III's ratio changes
Oscillator III through its own filter
A 5V trigger when any of the three ratios changes
The three filtered oscillators added together and divided by three

notes: nothing is heard until a clock reaches the Sync input or the TAP button is tapped; the three oscillators take their frequency from the measured tempo.
a SYNC3XL Levels expander placed immediately to the right multiplies all four audio outputs by its own knobs, and those knobs start at zero, so a freshly placed expander silences this module.
each of the six mode buttons steps to the next mode when clicked. Hovering one names the mode and its number; right-click and you can type either to jump straight to it.
the panel artwork is a wireframe outline with almost no lettering on it, so the tooltips are the only naming the controls have.
menu: Optimized — runs the oscillators through the plugin's faster path, which is the setting to leave it on; found under the CPU Mode heading
Direct Port — runs the hardware firmware straight through, which costs more CPU; found under the CPU Mode heading
Select Scale Set File — loads a scale file from disk in place of the one the module ships with
